summary.text: Jeffrey Goley is a Democratic former state representative seeking to return to the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 21, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Goley as having served in the House from 2004 to 2024 and as a captain in the Manchester Fire Department.

paragraphs.text: Jeffrey Goley's career experience includes working as a captain in the Manchester Fire Department.
Goley has served as vice president of the National Assembly of Sportsmen's Caucuses and as a moderator of Manchester Ward 1.
Goley served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, with Ballotpedia listing Goley's years in office as 2004 to 2024.

In the 2019-2020 session Goley chaired the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee, and in 2023-2024 Goley served on that committee and was vice chair of the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee.
Goley won re-election in 2022 but did not file to run in 2024; he advanced from the Democratic primary for Hillsborough 21 on September 8, 2026.
